main.description: Replace a package profile the caller has already published, held to the rules publishProfile applies. This is how a publisher edits a profile: it writes to the caller's own repo as them, where com.atproto.repo.putRecord sent through a HappyView instance goes wherever that instance's proxy routing points. It never creates a profile; publish a new one with publishProfile.

slug.description: The package slug: the record key of the profile to replace.

swapCid.description: The CID the profile was read at. The write is refused with InvalidSwap if the profile has changed since.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The caller's identity could not be determined, so there is no repo to write to.

errors.name: InvalidRecord
errors.description: The record is not a profile the indexer would accept. The message names the reason.

errors.name: ProfileMissing
errors.description: No profile is indexed at that slug for the caller.

errors.name: InvalidSwap
errors.description: The profile changed after swapCid was read.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The record could not be written to the caller's repo.

errors.name: NotConfigured
errors.description: The registry has no identity configured.
